parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
M1: Resolve either direction with the correct number of terms; allow sign errors and sine/cosine mix. Do not allow with just $\sin\alpha$ and $\cos\alpha$.
A1 horizontal populated routes: $(33+15)\times\frac35=P\cos\theta+30\cos\theta$; OR $(33+15)\cos(\tan^{-1}(4/3))=P\cos\theta+30\cos\theta$; OR $19.8+9=P\cos\theta+30\cos\theta$. Official allowed forms: $28.8=(P+30)\cos\theta$; $(33+15)\cos53(.1)=P\cos\theta+30\cos\theta$; $19.81+9.01=P\cos\theta+30\cos\theta$; $19.86+9.03=P\cos\theta+30\cos\theta$. OE, subject to the final-A1 note.
A1 vertical populated routes: $15\times\frac45+30\sin\theta=33\times\frac45+P\sin\theta$; OR $15\sin(\tan^{-1}(4/3))+30\sin\theta=33\sin(\tan^{-1}(4/3))+P\sin\theta$; OR $12+30\sin\theta=26.4+P\sin\theta$. Official allowed forms: $14.4=(30-P)\sin\theta$; $15\sin53(.1)+30\sin\theta=33\sin53(.1)+P\sin\theta$; $12.00+30\sin\theta=26.39+P\sin\theta$; $11.98+30\sin\theta=26.35+P\sin\theta$. OE, subject to the final-A1 note.
A1 (AG): Use $\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1$ with $\cos\theta=28.8/(P+30)$ and $\sin\theta=14.4/(30-P)$ to obtain the stated equation. Must show evidence of where 28.8 and 14.4 come from. A0 for any error or use of inexact angles. If 14.4 and/or 28.8 came from components rounded to 3 sf, maximum M1A1A1A0 (3/4). If exact $\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha$ are not shown (for example, 28.8 or 14.4 appears from no working), maximum M1A1A1A0 (3/4).
Printed total: 4.
